text_block_list.name: Rental Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Ines! Can I ask you to help out on the first floor?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You got it! The magazine section, right? I saw the delivery come in not long ago.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayooo! If it isn't Ines! ☆ Just finished work?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gack?! Helios?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, I see what ya got there! Being featured in that article is wild, Ines, no cap!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: They're calling you the front-runner for the Satsuki Sho! That's so lit! Like super hype!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, quit it with that stuff. Hey, it's pretty dark—wanna walk back together?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Say less, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm… "Exclusive Street Survey! The Umamusume to Watch at the Satsuki Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let's see why people chose me… "I watched her in the Asahi Hai," "She looks like my older sister." Hm, what else…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Because I wanted to see my dream in her."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Why would someone see their dream in me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I don't have any particular star qualities. I wonder if something resonated with them? Or maybe it's because I'm aiming for the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh. A dream, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Having the chance to compete in the Classic Triple Crown tour is definitely a dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I really need to show gratitude to my family for letting me chase my dreams like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brrring! Brrring!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello? Cassie and Polly?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, hehe, you've finished your dance lesson, huh? I just got back to the academy myself.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Ah… erm. Um, Big Sis… Good luck in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: Do your best to win! When it's time for the Derby, we'll all be there to cheer you on in person!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Me and Polly both love watching you race, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And I love when you watch me! I cherish you two more than anything in the world!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best to make you proud of your big sis!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It might be a G1 race just like the Asahi Hai F.S., but there are numerous differences.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The biggest difference is that it's the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown. You have to win here to have a chance at becoming Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Anything I missed?
choice_data_list: There's a lot more attention on you now.
There's a lot more attention on you now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, I think I'm already well aware of that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I get the sense that a lot of people are expecting great things from me. And I've got this fluttering feeling in my stomach.
choice_data_list: Your rivals have their eyes on you, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Rivals, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, very few of the other competitors considered Ines Fujin a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, this time around, she's most definitely been marked. There are likely some Umamusume who will stop at nothing to beat her.
choice_data_list: Be on your game from the start.
Be on your game from the start.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right. I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No matter how intense this race gets, I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And now, our eighteen racers make their way into the paddock for the start of the Satsuki Sho—the first battle of the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The crowd is really going wild.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh—Ryan! So you're…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You look like you're all ready to go today! You seem even more confident than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Good eye! The 2,000-meter Nakayama Racecourse is right up my alley.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's make this a good one, Ines. I'm going to run with everything I've got and seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's great. But I have no intention of losing either!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. This is race is going to be more than just a little heated!
